reviews.text: Рейтинг и свежие абзацы именно Google Maps в этом проходе автоматически не сняты. Карточка: ссылка ниже. Ниже — свежие verified-отзывы Trip.com (Jun–Aug 2026), явно не Google.
Ao 11N, Skyline Suite, family: views impeccable, location fantastic, meals excellent, pool and beach great; breakfast staff service awareness a bit below par. Trip.com.
Guest User, Deluxe City View: two-night stay; facilities complete, room clean, staff attentive; after 8 PM cool for a stroll. Trip.com.
Bol akno, Deluxe City View: best city hotel in Antalya; clean, excellent service, spacious grounds, great beach club; sun hits beach late morning but panoramic pool empty then. Trip.com.
✨X✨, Grand Family Sea View: huge gym, three pools, elevator to sea; plentiful breakfast; connecting rooms good for families; friendly staff. Trip.com.
Kuailech uxing339, Deluxe Sea View: valet and smooth check-in; 7th-floor sea view; five pools, gym, cliff setting; generous breakfast+dinner package. Trip.com.
Yase Min: семья с 2 детьми — сервис и еда замечательные, hammam/spa расслабили; минус — камни у входа в море и лежаки заняты к 11:00. Google via Tripplo.
Heidi Richards: поздний прилёт после полуночи — тёплый приём и ужин до 2 ночи; буфеты, коктейли Begonya с видом на море. Google via Tripplo.
Alina Los Angeles: неделя в конце мая; Room Manager Emre Erdem, Guest Relations Meltem İleri и Irina, pool bar Ömer Çelik — персонал выше всяких похвал. Google via Tripplo.
Derya Hitchcock: family suite 2060 просторный; персонал дружелюбный; море скалистое для малыша 17 мес., много бассейнов. Google via Tripplo.
jemma buck: 11 ночей; коктейли Furkan K и Ali Kemal у pool bar; kids club и mini disco; еда и чистота на высоте. Google via Tripplo.
Third visit this year — facilities and service again 100%. Beach bar at sunset is a highlight. Google via Exa.
Brilliant holiday; groundskeeping excellent, staff helpful, food excellent. Only downside: TV not linked to Wi‑Fi for streaming. Google via Exa.
Welcomed like family; rooms spotless; staff attentive and one step ahead. Google via Exa.
Great time; guest relations manager Vural Sönmez arranged birthday; highly recommend. Google via Exa.
Team went above and beyond when one-year-old was briefly unwell — attentive and supportive. Google via Exa.
Family of three, winter sun + birthday/anniversary; refillable bottles, kind staff, food good off-season, patisserie under grapevine. Google via Exa.
Honeymoon 10 nights; impressive hotel and staff throughout; beachfront, ~40 min walk to Side old town. Google via Exa.
Amazing hotel: classy look, great pools, outstanding food and staff; cinema, bowling, spa. Google via Exa.
Dobedan Exclusive Belek mid-October 2 weeks; loved Jasmine Spa; Deluxe rep Nana very helpful. Google via Exa.
Beautiful hotel, helpful staff; changed rooms due to balcony smoke — without smoking issue would be a favourite. Google via Exa.
8th year at this property under new branding; staff treat returning guests like family. Google via Exa.
Kaan K: Cactus Mexican restaurant highlight; waitress handled a child’s moment with grace. Google via Tripplo.
NALİN Toprak: family-friendly; beach bar Şefi & Serkan; breakfast Eray; dinner Mehmet Kurt; Zen spa. Google via Tripplo.
Franzi Mitsch: Inan the optician rescued a baby bird; food amazing; loud live music till 11pm near kids pool building. Google via Tripplo.
Alina Maria Dragomir: family of four; child didn’t want to leave; fresh fish, slides, birthday setup in room. Google via Tripplo.
Natalia Czechowska: Signature by Kirman; GM Murat and Guest Relations Yüksel Arıcan. Google via Tripplo.
Early October with husband and son — hotel, staff and food faultless; best buffet in 6 Turkey visits. Google via Exa.
Staff friendly; entertainment team engaging; personal assistant Nazar outstanding support. Google via Exa.
Mini Club favourite — creative activities; team patient and caring. Google via Exa.
Second visit this year; excellent service (Sea Club coach Mustafa Devici); themed restaurants. Google via Exa.
Animation team from morning activities to evening shows full of energy. Google via Exa.
Faiq N: персонал улыбается и помогает, заезд понравился. Google (сводка на карточке).
Meltem K: большой и чистый отель, зоны номеров разделены. Google.
Third time; WhatsApp assistants outstanding (Çağla, Yaşar, Aleyna, Sıtkı). Google via Exa.
Perfect family break in 2-bedroom bungalow: clean, excellent service, beach with piers, water park, buffet. Google via Exa.
Pine trees and cats; top-tier service; theme nights; premium drinks; cheesecake at dessert bar. Google via Exa.
Third trip; staff great with kids; WhatsApp assistant until midnight; already booking again. Google via Exa.
Third time; WhatsApp assistants outstanding (Çağla, Yaşar, Aleyna, Sıtkı). (Google via Exa)
Katty B, семья: заезд без сбоев, номера чистые и ухоженные. Google.
Michelle Bryan, второй заезд: персонал не к чему придраться. Google.
9 nights; sea/pool view worth extra; drinks great; Ottoman à la carte and Italian snack bar. Google via Exa.
Honeymoon; location perfect; buses to Side/Manavgat 15–20 min; room large and clean. Google via Exa.
Rooms cleaned daily; food delicious with variety; staff kind and smiling. Google via Exa.
More 4★ than 5★ for some; clean; reception/cocktail/pool bar brilliant; food often lukewarm. Google via Exa.
